messages.author: 42a46eabab840c9c
messages.subject: Error with running occu single season models
parts:
Hey all!

I am analyzing occupancy of four snakes species and am using observation covariates and site covariates to understand trends.  I am getting an error when I try to run occu models with my observation covariates. The error says" Object of type "symbol" is not subsettable." 
Does anyone know what the issue could be? My site covariates run in models and I have double checked to make sure all my NA's match up so I'm not sure where to go from here.

Here is my code:

#Install unmarked library
library(unmarked)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(ggplot2)

#Import Salamander Data and Check Structure
snake <- read.csv("F:/Occurence- Standardized data.csv", header=TRUE)
str(snake)
#Pull out count matrix for salamander adults and larvae
agco.y <- snake[,c("agco_1", "agco_2", "agco_3", "agco_4", "agco_5", "agco_6", "agco_7", "agco_8", "agco_9")]
thsi.y <- snake[,c("thsi_1", "thsi_2", "thsi_3", "thsi_4", "thsi_5", "thsi_6", "thsi_7", "thsi_8", "thsi_9")]
stde.y <- snake[,c("stde_1", "stde_2", "stde_3", "stde_4", "stde_5", "stde_6", "stde_7", "stde_8", "stde_9")]
allspecies.y <- snake[,c("allspecies_1", "allspecies_2", "allspecies_3", "allspecies_4", "allspecies_5", "allspecies_6", "allspecies_7", "allspecies_8", "allspecies_9")]

# Load Site Covariates
siteCovs <- snake[,c("CPYMN_1000", "CPYMN_500", "CPYMN_250", "DEMMN_1000", "DEMMN_500", "DEMMN_250", "LAINMN_1000","LAINMN_500", "LAINMN_250", "NLCDdev_1000", "NLCDdev_500", "NLCDdev_250", "NLCDnat_1000", "NLCDnat_500", "NLCDnat_250", "NLCDag_1000", "NLCDag_500", "NLCDag_250", "NLCDwet_1000", "NLCDwet_500", "NLCDwet_250")]

obsCovs <-list(julian=snake[,c("julian_1","julian_2", "julian_3", "julian_4", "julian_5", "julian_6", "julian_7", "julian_8", "julian_9")],
             time=snake[,c("time_1", "time_2", "time_3", "time_4", "time_5", "time_6", "time_7", "time_8", "time_9")],
             airtemp=snake[,c("airtemp_1", "airtemp_2", "airtemp_3", "airtemp_4", "airtemp_5", "airtemp_6", "airtemp_7", "airtemp_8", "airtemp_9")],
             groundtemp=snake[,c("groundtemp_1", "groundtemp_2", "groundtemp_3","groundtemp_4", "groundtemp_5", "groundtemp_6", "groundtemp_7", "groundtemp_8", "groundtemp_9")],
             bp=snake[,c("bp_1", "bp_2", "bp_3", "bp_4", "bp_5", "bp_6", "bp_7", "bp_8", "bp_9")],
             dewp=snake[,c("dewp_1", "dewp_2", "dewp_3", "dewp_4", "dewp_5", "dewp_6", "dewp_7", "dewp_8", "dewp_9")],
             hsi=snake[,c("hsi_1", "hsi_2", "hsi_3", "hsi_4", "hsi_5", "hsi_6", "hsi_7", "hsi_8", "hsi_9")],
             humid=snake[,c("humid_1", "humid_2", "humid_3", "humid_4", "humid_5", "humid_6", "humid_7", "humid_8","humid_9")])

# Load and create unmarkedFrame for each salamander species and life stage
agco.umf <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=agco.y, siteCovs=siteCovs, obsCovs=obsCovs)
summary(agco.umf)
thsi.umf <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=thsi.y, siteCovs=siteCovs, obsCovs=obsCovs)
summary(thsi.umf)      
         
stde.umf <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=stde.y, siteCovs=siteCovs, obsCovs=obsCovs)
summary(stde.umf)
         
allspecies.umf <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=allspecies.y, siteCovs=siteCovs, obsCovs=obsCovs)
summary(allspecies.umf)

Jim
